create_OptimizationPrinter: create an OptimizationPrinter callback to print optimizer recommendations at regular intervals
create_OptimizationLogger: create an OptimizationLogger callback to log optimizer recommendations to a Python logger
create_ParametersLogger: create a ParametersLogger callback to log optimization parameters and losses to a JSON file
create_ProgressBar: create a ProgressBar callback to display a tqdm progress bar during optimization
create_EarlyStopping: create an EarlyStopping callback to stop optimization when a custom criterion is met
